name: Drop Gate Probe
author: vkays
description: A probe, not content. Answers one question: does CWasDamagedByPlayerAction return true when only a COMPANION damaged the creature? It is the only damaged/killed test class in the game, 648 uses, and it gates experience and every drop from the Destroyed Effect Action. If the answer is no, the aggro valve costs the player xp and loot every time it works. The empty Else branch of ten wolf cans now prints GATE FALSE and the Then branch prints GATE TRUE while keeping every original action, so the gate reports its own answer instead of being inferred from whether xp appeared. Both branches also decode what $Instigator resolves to at death. Reaches any wolf spawned after install. Uninstall before testing anything else.
